move: windows pop into a grid, pages scroll, camera dives in, tips away
how: Six 340px-tall browser mockups fill a 1680px-wide 3-column grid pre-set to scale 0.62, rotate -3, y 20. Windows from() scale 0.6, y 120, opacity 0 with 0.9s expo.out in a centre-out grid stagger (0.09s) from 0.5% of the 9s; headline lines rise from yPercent 110 and colour cards rise with back.out(1.6); the grid settles to scale 0.74, rotate 0, y 0 with 1.4s expo.out at 3%. At 19% every page scrolls y -130 with power3.inOut in a start-to-end grid wave. At 36% the grid pushes to scale 1.5, y 282 with 1.6s expo.inOut so window two fills the frame and its page scrolls a further y -260; at 60% the grid pulls back to 0.74 and the pages return to y 0 in an end-first wave. At 89% windows fall y 140, scale 0.7, opacity 0 with expo.in staggered from the edges while the grid tips to scale 0.62, rotate 3 (power2.in) and the title fades.
adapt: Replace the six site records (url, name, accent, two-line headline, three card colours, dark flag) and the title; change which window the camera dives into by adjusting the y 282 target and the .w1 selector. Keep the 0.9s expo.out pops, the 1.6s expo.inOut push/pull and the grid waves.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the grid from shot.sites and applies the initial gsap.set; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with pops at 0.005D, settle at 0.033D, scroll wave at 0.19D, push at 0.356D, pull at 0.6D and exit at 0.89D. The grid stagger needs grid:[2,3]; from() tweens should be fromTo with immediateRender:false; the 1680px grid and y 282 push target assume a 1280x720 frame.
caveats: from() tweens on windows, headlines, cards and title have default immediateRender
the grid is wider than the frame (1680px at scale 0.74) so edges are cropped by design
loop closes visually: windows are hidden at both ends, though the grid rotate ends at +3 instead of -3
